_comment: JEV2-H2O (jev2_h2o_shim, A-PREREG-JEV2-H2O, NOT submitted): the JEV2-4B recipe (same balanced jev2 mix, 4k, LS 0.05 / noul 0, score ~25%, calib slice) INITIALISED FROM H2O-Lightning-4B v1.1 (h2oai/h2o-lightning-4b@193ad740, Apache-2.0; every weight file sha256-pinned and verified at load), layout g1v2; LoRA LR 0.4x, 800 max steps; dev cards select on the held-out calib slice; worst-case hold <= $60
head: fork

heldout_excluded.reason: the merged draw inherits each pool's gates (0 held-out D1-B hits each); the in-job heldout phase rescans the whole set

exclude.rule: 97 Glaive rows whose tool descriptions are verbatim in JevBench easy tool_selection items + 8 MuSiQue rows; asserted at build (sha + count)

jev2c.note: 1,500 long_policy rows, prose states, explicit criteria, 2,001-3,347 tokens; the ONLY long_policy source (jev1 long_policy excluded). A jev2c-v2 replaces it by swapping dir / pointer / pointer_sha256 here (and the --src in the build command).

train_set.note: build: python -X utf8 -I scripts/jev12_balanced_draw.py --src <data>/m2/build/bschema-draw-jev1 --src <data>/m2/build/bschema-draw-jev2a --src <data>/m2/build/bschema-draw-jev2c [--src <data>/m2/build/bschema-draw-jev2b] --exclude long_policy=bschema-draw-jev1 --family-cap adequacy=293 --score-share 0.25 --pool-exclude bschema-draw-jev2a=receipts/2026-10-10-jev2a-regate/jev2a_exclude_ids.txt --pool-exclude-sha bschema-draw-jev2a=aeb8027aaaebdb6fad2b24f8b5bee9d37c4e176fcc4e18ad0d366acf1b579705 --pool-rows bschema-draw-jev2a=29895 [--pool-exclude/--pool-exclude-sha/--pool-rows for jev2b once its re-gate list exists] --dedupe-source glaive_fc --deprioritize-empty-score --train-per-family 586 --calib-per-family 200 --name bschema-draw-jev2-mix --out <data>/m2/build. jev1 long_policy is never drawn; long_policy only from jev2c; jev1 adequacy at half weight; score rows ~25% via per-family quotas; Glaive (glaive_fc) rows deduped to one per request text (1,838 duplicates dropped from tool_selection in the provisional build); score rows with empty level criteria fill at most half a family's score quota and only after rubric rows (0 needed in the provisional build). n_train_records == its n_train: the whole balanced draw once.
train_set.type_mix_note: score-type rows weighted to ~25% (jevkit score items 7.8% of public items, ~1/3 of Intelligence); PROVISIONAL 13-family mix after the jev2a re-gate: choice 40.5% / noul 34.5% / score 25.1% (2,963 / 2,527 / 1,835 of 7,325)

lora_rank_note: r=64 on every arm (A-PREREG-SIZECLIFF: same LoRA rank); targets = every GDN in_proj_qkv / in_proj_z / out_proj, every attention q / k / v / o and every MLP projection (stock hybrid, heads.backbone.qwen35_spec from config.json)
train_max_k_note: D8 code (#221 on agent-main): K cap of the training items only (train.run_cell.train_max_k; cell_items default, also used by the m2_gates lineage rebuild); max_k 16 remains the eval cap (train.m2_gates.unit_spec, run_cell eval_items). B1 100k-v2 carries rows with > 16 options (BANKING77 77-option catalogs, Glaive catalog views K 17-27), which max_k 16 alone would drop.
row_options_note: execution guard (train.trainer.row_groups / single_cont_fits): <= 160 forked continuations per backbone call; a row with K > 160 runs alone, and a step whose summed K exceeds 160 runs per group under cont_plan single. Worst call = 8,192 prefix tokens + 160 copies ~= 53.8 GB (tvuat ladder 1,024 rung) + 80 x <= 87 MB ~= 61 GB < 76 GB stop (D8 sizing). Not in the TrainConfig hash; never binds on K <= 16 steps (8 x 16 = 128).
anti_collapse_note: train/trainer.py TrainConfig anti-collapse fields; each absent key = the old behaviour. lr_schedule and collapse_* are in the config hash; dev_card_* and best_ckpt are operational. Each dev card scores 200 rows (budget it inside max_minutes).
execution_note: row_batch 1: one row per backbone call (8 rows / optimiser step via grad_accum 8); act_ckpt true (heads/act_ckpt.py covers Qwen3.5 decoders); the cache fork reads each row's prompt once and forks its K continuations. row_plan / cont_plan / row_options only act with row_batch > 1 (train/trainer.py). The clock binds (max_steps 20,000).
v3w_note: generic v3w (decide/v3w_generic.py, PINNED_SPEC_SHA256 'jrt-v3w-generic:qwen3.5' 2e4907ee...; 255 single-token codes after the Qwen answer prefix, word ids by unique first token, Qwen3.5 chat template with enable_thinking=False -> empty think block, budget 16,383). Bound to the snapshot's own tokenizer files on the box (run_cell / score_parent / m2_gates / screen): any other tokenizer or template fails closed.

qwen35.label: H2O-Lightning-4B v1.1 + SSDM
qwen35.note: EV-PREREG-H2O-HOST (state 94d38f43 + amendment 857592e9): the v1.1 tag the host scan / kit parity / the card ran (205/231). heads.backbone.qwen35_pin_check (QWEN35_HOSTS) checks repo@revision, config.json, the snapshot directory commit and the sha256 of model.safetensors before any weight is read, and the loader refuses any missing text weight; the runner checks the whole snapshot manifest, the HF-resolved commit and the LICENSE / README git blobs, and copies them into out/license. The tokenizer / chat template files are byte-identical to Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B@851bf6e (same sha256), so the pinned shim template identity binds unchanged.

shim_note: template jrt-h2o-shim:qwen3.5-4b (decide/shim_format.py, pinned identity): the vendored, unmodified H2O-Lightning-4B v1.1 shim prompt (third_party/h2o_lightning_shim, the host scan's replica that matched H2O's card 205/231): Qwen chat turn, thinking off, the shim system text, 'record: / question: / options: A) name: desc', 'Answer:' prefill; option k = shim label k (A, B, ...), its continuation the ONE token of ' <label>' (the shim's own probe); bound to the snapshot's tokenizer files, any other tokenizer fails closed. Train rows == the shim prompt ids (and == transformers' whole-string tokenization = vLLM /tokenize): scripts/check_sizecliff_cpu.py.
budget_note: A-PREREG-JEV2-H2O: worst-case hold <= $60. clock 305 = ceil(800 x 16.9 s/step x 1.3 / 60) + 10 dev-card minutes, rounded up to 5. s/step = JEV2's 16.6 estimate / 0.985 (g1v2 vs sym-fork token factor, 42388c2c sym_reprice_note); the step-10 rate check re-measures it in job.
sym_reprice_note: Clock re-price (CPU 2026-10-10, real Qwen3.5-4B tokenizer, systematic 1-in-24 sample of bschema-draw-jev1 = 4,000 items, all kept by train.run_cell.keep_item under both layouts; K mean 4.78, max 16): tokens the backbone RUNS per row (prefix + continuation calls right-padded per cont_chunk 64 chunk, MIN_CONT_WIDTH 2) g1v2 368.1 vs sym-fork 362.7, factor 0.985 (fed tokens without padding 363.3 vs 352.1, 0.969): the options move from the prefix into the continuations, about token-neutral. Projected 10.92 x 0.985 = 10.76 s/step -> ceil(1,121 x 10.76 x 1.3 / 60) = 262 min; max_minutes stays 270 (the measured g1v2 budget; the factor is a token model, not a measurement: the step-10 rate check (exit 26) re-measures it in-job). Script: scripts/sym_reprice_jev1.py 24 (receipt in docs/PROOF_INVARIANCE.md).
max_len_note: public long_policy items are 2,350-3,952 tokens (r2 preds usage.input_tokens) vs jev1 long_policy train rows p50 935 / max 1,263 (build-report): the trained head never saw > 2k contexts. 4,096 for training (t_ladder top rung; require_t_max fails closed instead of silently dropping rows > T_max) and eval. Memory at 4k on H100 80 GB (4B, act_ckpt): the attention-layer KV copy per forked option grows ~0.7 GB at T 1,020 (cf3929b) -> ~2.8 GB at 4,096; long_policy rows carry K 4-6 -> <= ~17 GB of copies + ~8 GB weights + checkpointed activations; the cont_chunk probe (4b0fb1d) re-picks the chunk over the worst K x T rows <= 4,096 (candidates 8..64, peak <= 0.85 x 76 GB) and ladder_probe_longest steps the LONGEST rows of each rung (the max-K rung rows are short), so 4k is measured before training.
label_smoothing_note: yes/no (noul) rows: eps 0 (sharp targets). jevkit scores a noul answer with p in (0.2, 0.8) as WRONG; r2 put 10/74 noul items in that band (stock 0), the whole argmax-vs-jevkit gap (claude/ev-j1-rescore @a8ca3e7e), and smoothing pulls yes/no answers toward 0.5. choice / score rows: eps 0.05 (was the clef default 0.1 on every row; r2's head was under-confident, shim T 0.8 raised its Capability 57.93 -> 59.62). Per-row eps by question type (train.losses.arm_loss already receives qtypes).
noul_band_gate: reported gate: the native arm's yes/no 0.2-0.8 band rate on the 231 items <= stock_shim's (screen.jevkit_report noul_band_gate); the calib-slice band rate at T = 1 and at the fitted T are reported, and T is moved toward 1 if it would raise the slice band rate (constrain_t_by_band)
lr_horizon_note: lr_horizon_frac 0.6717 (= r2's 753 / 1,121): at the step-10 rate check the planned final step = min(max_steps 1281, step + the clock-affordable steps at the MEASURED s/step) and the cosine horizon = frac x that, fixed once. If the projection is short of max_steps the run CONTINUES (cell.json train_budget_shortened records it) down to min_steps 600; below that, exit 26. Planned (estimate holds): horizon 860.

calib_slice.rule: per JevBench family, ascending sha256('<seed>:<id>'), the next 200 after the train rows (scripts/jev12_balanced_draw.py); id AND content disjoint from training; never JevBench items
calib_slice.use: EV-PREREG-AREA-TEMP addendum: T_J / per-family T_f fitted on this slice only (never public-231); the screen exports every slice decision's per-option probabilities (calib_probs.jsonl) and fits the scalar native_tfit T in job (tfit.json)
calib_slice.ids_note: PROVISIONAL (13 gated families x 200): refill from the final draw-report

assert_no_truncation_note: fail closed (run_cell exit 25 'data') if ANY drawn training question is dropped by the K / T filter at tokenization or by the measured T_max; jev2c has 1,448 / 1,500 rows > 2,048 tokens (max 3,347), all inside 4,096. The screen fails (9) if any JevBench item is refused for input length (jevkit.assert_no_truncation).
host_init_note: Continued fine-tuning of an already-tuned model. LoRA LR 4e-5 = 0.4x JEV2's 1e-4: H2O's features already carry its 77.6 open-I; the LoRA is a correction (4k long_policy, noul band, score rows, jev2 families), and a full-LR update on a tuned init is the classic forgetting regime. The fork HEAD is new (randomly initialised on any host), so lr_head stays 3e-4. Steps: max 800 (0.62x JEV2's 1,281) = 6,400 rows, a prefix of the random permutation of the balanced draw (family-balanced in expectation); integrated LoRA update lr x steps = 0.25x JEV2's. The step-10 measured-rate logic is unchanged (plan = min(800, affordable), horizon = 0.6717 x plan, continue down to min_steps 400, exit 26 below).
dev_card_note: dev_card_records: best-checkpoint selection (dev-card NLL) and the collapse guard read 360 hash-sampled rows of the held-out calib slice (m2-jev2mix-calib, id- and content-disjoint from training, ids sha pinned = calib_slice.ids_sha256; train.run_cell.dev_card_source fails closed on any other ids), never public-231 and never the cohort. The same slice also fits native_tfit (calibration); both are pre-registered held-out uses.
min_steps_note: floor 400 steps (3,200 rows): the step-10 rate check continues with the affordable steps and exits 26 only if fewer than min_steps are affordable
g1_note: shim mode: options are listed in the prompt with shim labels, so reorder / relabel invariance is NOT by construction; G1 (perturb_ops) is reported as a secondary, not a gate
